quote: Payments for computer hardware prepayments included payments of $583.6 million relating to mining hardware purchases and $41.8 million relating to NVIDIA H200 GPUs purchases. The $583.6 million mining hardware purchases and $41.8 million NVIDIA H200 GPUs purchases were paid in respect of the Hardware Purchases Agreements as outlined in "Hardware Purchases" included within this MD&A.
